matches.rationale: Findings 4 and 5 identify the exact Theorem 2.3 defect: the map/construction only determines or represents the conjugation when the relevant Hodge component has dimension at most 1, and the proof wrongly treats one scalar equation as determining an element in higher dimension. Findings 1-2 concern Corollary/Example issues and Finding 3 is an unrelated degree shift.
